CustomField.formula: IF( stayclassy__Canonical_URL__c = null, IF(stayclassy__sc_event_id__c > 0 && ISPICKVAL(stayclassy__Classy_Campaign_Type__c, "Fundraiser"), "https://classy.org/fundraiser/" & text(stayclassy__sc_event_id__c), IF(stayclassy__sc_event_id__c > 0 && ISPICKVAL(stayclassy__Classy_Campaign_Type__c, "Team"), "https://classy.org/team/" & text(stayclassy__sc_event_id__c), IF(stayclassy__sc_event_id__c > 0 && ISPICKVAL(stayclassy__Classy_Campaign_Type__c, "Campaign") && ISPICKVAL(Type, "Studio"), "https://giving.classy.org/campaign/" & text(stayclassy__sc_event_id__c) & "/donate", IF(stayclassy__sc_event_id__c > 0 && ISPICKVAL(stayclassy__Classy_Campaign_Type__c, "Campaign") && ISPICKVAL(Type, "Ticketed") || ISPICKVAL(Type, "Registration with Fundraising"), "https://classy.org/event/e" & text(stayclassy__sc_event_id__c), IF(stayclassy__sc_event_id__c > 0 && ISPICKVAL(stayclassy__Classy_Campaign_Type__c, "Campaign") && ISPICKVAL(Type, "Donation"), "https://classy.org/give/" & text(stayclassy__sc_event_id__c) & "/#!/donation/checkout", IF(stayclassy__sc_event_id__c > 0 && ISPICKVAL(stayclassy__Classy_Campaign_Type__c, "Campaign"), "https://classy.org/campaign/c" & text(stayclassy__sc_event_id__c), "" )))))), stayclassy__Canonical_URL__c )
